data.name: FIRST Global Winning Alliance Award - Gold
data.desc: Awarded to the four teams in the winning alliance in the final match.

data.name: FIRST Global Innovator Award, in honor of Fred Smith
data.desc: Awarded to teams who developed their own innovative solutions to address food sustainability as part of the New Technology Experience: Eco Equilibrium

data.name: Zhang Heng Award for Engineering Design
data.desc: Awarded to teams whose robot exhibits excellent engineering and displays elegance and effectiveness during the Challenge.

data.name: Ustad Ahmad Lahori Award for Innovation in Engineering
data.desc: Awarded to teams that demonstrate creativity and innovation in building their robot to complete an aspect of the Challenge.

data.name: Dr. Mae Jemison Award for International Unity
data.desc: Awarded to teams that emulate the best qualities of FIRST Global by breaking down barriers, demonstrating Gracious Professionalism, and building bridges with fellow teams.

data.name: Judges Award
data.desc: During the course of the competition, the judging panel may decide a team’s unique efforts, performance or dynamics merit recognition.

data.name: Francisco José de Caldas Award for Sustainable Excellence
data.desc: Awarded to an individual who helped contribute to strong and sustainable FIRST Global programs.

data.name: Outstanding Mentor Award
data.desc: Awarded to mentors who went above and beyond the call of duty for their team.

data.name: Albert Einstein Award for FIRST Global International Excellence
data.desc: Awarded to teams whose robots performed the best during the FIRST Global Challenge and exemplified all tenets of the FIRST Global community.

data.name: FIRST Global Grand Challenge Award
data.desc: Awarded to teams that accrue the most cumulative points over the course of the competition.

data.name: New Technology Experience Research Posters
data.desc: Recognizes the teams who created outstanding research posters for their New Technology Experience project.

data.name: Katherine Johnson Award for Engineering Documentation
data.desc: Awarded to teams that demonstrate the journey they took in building their robot.

data.name: Jackie Bezos Award for International Enthusiasm
data.desc: Awarded to teams who support each other and other teams throughout the Challenge.

data.name: Rajaâ Cherkaoui El Moursli Award for Courageous Achievement
data.desc: Awarded to teams that exhibit a “can-do” attitude throughout the Challenge, even under difficult circumstances, or when things do not go as planned.

data.name: Skills Challenge
data.desc: Awarded to the top-scoring teams in the Skills Challenge, which consists of a solo performance by a robot as it plays the Eco Equilibrium robotics game.

data.name: Video Storytelling Award
data.desc: Recognizes teams that impactfully told their story through their team profile video.

data.name: Social Media Challenge Award
data.desc: Awarded to teams that have participated in a majority of the online Social Media Challenges hosted throughout the season.
